notes: «وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ» opens with the speaker named: a single-link route (rule 8)
«قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» makes the Imam the one asked, who answers, so he is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The second question and the Imam's further words in the same report have no own isnad and stay in the same route
